## The Big Question

-   How field metabolic rate (FMR) scales with body mass in individual birds and mammals, and the degree of variation in this relationship across different taxonomic levels.

## Best Figure - Figure! {.nostretch}

![](https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/cms/asset/7ddff2df-a69c-4c73-87bf-f5ae947e43e5/jane12086-fig-0001-m.jpg){fig-align="center"}

## Best Figure - Interp!

-   This figure presents two scatter plots that illustrate the linear relationship between the body mass and field metabolic rate in birds (Aves) and mammals (Mammalia). Both plots show a strong positive correlation between body mass and FMR.
-   This figure uses the colors and shapes of the data point strategically, helping us to distinguish individual birds and mammals, even though there are a lot of them.

## Random Effects Model Description

-   Response variable: metabolic rate (quantitative).
-   Model type (family and link function): linear mixed-effects model with log link function.
-   Fixed effects predictors: aves & mammalia.
-   Random effects: order, family & species.
